“If I were aware of being at fault in this, I would not have 6
come here, but would have made a life for myself some-
where in the wide earth. So I think your royal majesty should
carefully investigate the case against me through some arbi-
ter who is very just, does not falsify the truth, and shows no
partiality nor lends his ear to those who are jealous, since
there are many such people around me because the king
used to be well-disposed toward me. And if you will not do
this, I have no other recourse except the compassion of
God, who tries hearts and minds. In addition to this, I am not
afraid of death, for I know it is determined and inevitable,
and that every living being is mortal, even if he has ten thou
sand souls.
About an adulterous wife.
“Moreover, wise men have said that someone who trusts in
the resemblance of things will suffer what the foolish
woman did, who let herself be molested by her own slave.
For it is said that there was a merchant in some city who had
a very beautiful wife. But the wife was in love with a painter,
and so she said to her lover, the painter, ‘Can’t you make
something, so that, when you are coming to me, I will see it
and come out without us speaking?’ He said, ‘I can do that
very easily.’ He took a scarf and painted it with her likeness
